notes.convention: Body +x = fast axis at fastAxisDegBeamLocal=0. Rotate by setting fastAxisDegBeamLocal or applying a binding rotation around body +z (the optical axis).
notes.geometryRef: Uses the existing WPHSM05 SM05-mount STL as the mechanical envelope; optical spec is WPHSM05-780.
notes.aperture: Thorlabs lists a 10.0 mm clear aperture. Face apertureMm stores radius, so both optical faces use 5.0 mm.
notes.faceConvention: Canonical v3 two-port topology uses physical faces A/B. Forward and reverse behavior is represented by directed transitions A->B and B->A. Both directions use the same reciprocal Jones waveplate matrix.
